immediate_fix.rationale: Verified: rotate() ignores renameTo/delete results and write() then opens naruserve.log with append=false, truncating the live log when the final rename fails (maxFiles>1). Silent data loss, not counted in droppedCount. No FR-APP-017 AC requires truncation on a failed rename.
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: Make rotate() return whether naruserve.log was moved away (final renameTo result; for maxFiles==1 the delete result). In write(), open with append=false only when rotation succeeded; otherwise reopen with append=true and keep size = file.length(). Add a RotatingFileLoggerTest case where the rename fails (e.g. pre-create naruserve.log.1 as a non-empty directory) asserting earlier records survive.

immediate_fix.rationale: Verified: filelog/logcat/slf4j package-info.java carry no @NullMarked and no class is annotated, so the public API reaches Kotlin as platform types (CLAUDE.md / object.md 12). The package-info.java files are outside the lease, but jspecify 1.0.0 is compileOnly for every naru module (build.gradle:76) and @NullMarked targets TYPE, so a class-level fix fits inside the write set.
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: Annotate the classes RotatingFileLogger (covers nested Builder), LogcatLogger and Slf4jLogger with @org.jspecify.annotations.NullMarked; mark Throwable parameters that may be null (RotatingFileLogger.log/format error) @Nullable. Do not touch package-info.java (out_of_lease). No signature change.

immediate_fix.rationale: Genuine bug, trivial: close() does queue.put(STOP) without checking writer.isAlive(); if the writer died from an Error and the queue is full, shutdown hangs in the logger-close step. flush() already guards this.
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: In close(), replace queue.put(STOP) with a loop on queue.offer(STOP, 100, MILLISECONDS) that breaks when !writer.isAlive(), mirroring flush(); keep the interrupt bookkeeping.

immediate_fix.rationale: Genuine contract bug, trivial: log() runs format() (error.printStackTrace, user toString) on the caller thread unguarded, so a logging call can throw despite the no-throw contract (LogcatLogger guards the same case).
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: Wrap format() in log() in try/catch(RuntimeException) and count the record as dropped.

immediate_fix.rationale: Genuine bug, trivial: build.gradle:59 declares slf4j-api as implementation while the public constructor Slf4jLogger(org.slf4j.Logger) exposes the type, so consumers cannot compile against it.
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: Move 'org.slf4j:slf4j-api:1.7.36' from implementation to api in the NaruServe-slf4j mainDependencies entry.

immediate_fix.rationale: Verified: lifecycleThread is one volatile field set/cleared by both listen() (finally sets null) and runShutdownSequence(); listen's finally can wipe the value a concurrent shutdown thread just set, so an onStop callback calling shutdown() waits on itself for its full timeout.
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: Make lifecycleThread a private AtomicReference<Thread> and clear it with compareAndSet(Thread.currentThread(), null) in both listen()'s finally and runShutdownSequence()'s finally; read via get() for ownThread. Add a test that forces the window (shutdown on B right after RUNNING while listen's finally is held, onStop calls shutdown) and asserts it returns promptly.

immediate_fix.rationale: Verified: shutdown() from a route handler wins beginStop on the request thread and runs runShutdownSequence inline; adapter.stop waits for in-flight exchanges including the caller, burning the full timeout and force-closing its own response. No AC mandates this; --auto MEDIUM -> immediate_fix.
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: Mark request threads with a ThreadLocal set/cleared around request handling in GatedExchangeHandler (or Dispatcher.handle). In DefaultRestApp.shutdown's RUNNING case, when called on a marked thread and beginStop() wins, run runShutdownSequence(deadline) on a new non-daemon thread and return without waiting for TERMINATED. Add a test: handler calls app.shutdown(5, SECONDS); the response is delivered, the call returns well before 5 s, the app reaches TERMINATED. Update docs/api/lifecycle.md to state the behaviour (CLAUDE.md: API docs follow API changes).

immediate_fix.rationale: Genuine bug, small: AccessLog copies the flags at freeze but calls options.excluded() live (synchronized) per request, so exclude() after listen() bypasses the NEW-state guard (IR-APP-007 AC-3) and contradicts 'fixed at listen()'.
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: Snapshot the exclude set in the AccessLog constructor (copy under the options lock via a package-private snapshot method on DefaultAccessLogOptions) and check that unmodifiable set lock-free in write(), with the same matching rule as excluded().

immediate_fix.rationale: Genuine bug, small: use(prefix, mw) checks only the leading '/'; an undecodable prefix such as "/%zz" fails inside freeze() at listen() and drives the app to FAILED/TERMINATED permanently, while route patterns are validated at registration.
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: In use(prefix, mw), validate the prefix the same way PrefixMatcher decodes it (Router.decodeSegments with the app's policy) before recording, rethrowing as IllegalArgumentException naming the prefix. Add an AppEntryApiTest case.

immediate_fix.rationale: Genuine bug, small: MiddlewarePipeline drops every exception once chain.errorRouted is set, with no log, so a different later exception disappears silently. Logging it does not break the 'no second error path' rule.
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: Record the routed instance in ChainNext.Chain when next.error(e) runs; in MiddlewarePipeline's catch, when errorRouted and the caught exception is not that instance, log it at ERROR (with requestId) through the ErrorPath's SafeLogger; keep not rethrowing.

immediate_fix.rationale: Verified: LoggerIsolationTest asserts only total logger.calls >= 3 / >= 5, so FR-APP-014 AC-2 (flush and close reached and throwing) is not checked, and a RuntimeException from flush() is never exercised.
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: Count flush and close separately and assert each == 1 after shutdown; add a variant whose flush() throws RuntimeException; for AC-1 assert per-method counters (error/info) > 0. Test-only strengthening.

immediate_fix.rationale: Genuine test bug, one line: the try/catch NullPointerException around get("/x", null, h) has no fail(), so a regressed null check passes silently at that point.
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: Add fail("expected NullPointerException") after the get(...) call inside the try.

immediate_fix.rationale: Verified: several SKIPS entries for blocks that call res.json/req.body name only an app-defined type (README.md block #1, express-migration onStart, middleware.md '/users/:id', request.md use/get), against OPS-APP-002 AC-2 which requires the later-wave member's name.
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: For each listed entry, confirm the block calls res.json(...) or req.body(...) and switch its reason to the JSON/BODY constant (or JSON + " and app-defined type `User`"). Optionally assert that any skipped block containing '.json(' or 'req.body(' has a reason naming the JSON/BODY member.

immediate_fix.rationale: Verified: FR-APP-012 AC-2 requires 'shutdown returns after listen() ended', but the test accepts either order, and shutdown's STARTING branch waits only for TERMINATED, which is set before listen() throws.
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: Add a listen-completion signal released in listen()'s finally; in shutdown's STARTING branch (non-own thread) wait for it within the deadline after awaitTerminated. Tighten ShutdownStatesTest to assert 'listen threw' precedes 'shutdown returned'.

immediate_fix.rationale: Verified: throwAfterNextError builds ErrorPath with no onError handlers and asserts only status/commits; a second error-path pass would be a no-op on a COMPLETED response, so the property in the test name is unchecked.
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: Register a recording ErrorHandler in the ErrorPath (that does not answer, so the standard 500 still applies) and assert it received e exactly once.

immediate_fix.rationale: Verified: sdsAc8 sleeps 200 ms in a 1 s budget and requires stop to get 500-800 ms; scheduler overshoot can break the lower bound (timing-dependent flake).
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: Keep the property, raise the noise margin: timeout 10 s, assert stopNanos <= timeout - 200 ms (the sleep was deducted from the one deadline) and stopNanos >= timeout - 200 ms - 2 s.

immediate_fix.rationale: Verified: the recording logger is a java.lang.reflect.Proxy recording method names only, so error(String,Object) and error(String,Throwable) are indistinguishable (FR-APP-018 AC-1), and AC-4 asks for a hand-written implementation, which a dynamic proxy is not.
immediate_fix.fix_hypothesis: Replace the proxy with a hand-written test class extending org.slf4j.helpers.MarkerIgnoringBase (slf4j 1.7.36) recording distinct tags for trace/debug/info/warn/error(String) and error(String,Throwable) and failing on every other overload; keep the expected sequence.
